text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган emerges victorious at
the Arima
Kinen. As promised, I tell her
that she twinkled
brighter than anyone
else.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After finally hearing the words she has
wanted to
hear more than anything,
tears of happiness pour
down her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As the ceremony commemorating Narita
Brian's
final race approaches, Mayano
Top Gun selfishly
pleads with her to
continue racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having grown into a truly brilliant racer,
she
ultimately manages to keep Narita
Brian from
retiring.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
